title: First-pass work expression
description: Essential: The work done by the electric field in the first pass must be given as W₁ = (1/2) m v² (ν² - 1).

title: Electric field strength E_n
description: Essential: The expression for the electric field strength on the n-th pass must be E_n = [m v^(2n) (ν² - 1)] / (2 q n d).

title: Total time expression
description: Essential: The total time until the n-th electric field passage must be given as the sum of the magnetic field time nπm/(qB) and the electric field time series.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the work-energy theorem (W = ΔKE) to relate electric field work to the change in kinetic energy for each passage.

title: Magnetic circular motion period
description: Important: The solution must correctly state the period of circular motion in the magnetic field as T = 2πm/(qB) and account for half-periods spent in the field.

title: Velocity progression recognition
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify that the velocity after the k-th electric field passage is v_k = ν^k * v (initial v).

title: Electric field width progression
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly note that the width of the electric field for the n-th pass is d_n = n d.

title: Series summation handling
description: Optional: The solution may show the summation of the electric field transit times as a series, t_e = (2d/(ν+1)) Σ (k/ν^k) from k=1 to n.

title: Sign or variable confusion
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses the velocity multiplication factor ν with the instantaneous speed v, or mislabels them.

title: Incorrect kinetic energy change
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the change in kinetic energy for the n-th pass is miscalculated, e.g., using v^(n) instead of v^(2n) in the energy difference.
